# pve_acme_dns_plugin (Data Source)

Reads a single ACME DNS challenge plugin (`GET /cluster/acme/plugins/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_acme_dns_plugin" "pdns" {
  plugin = "pdns"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin` (String) Unique identifier of the ACME plugin instance to read.

### Read-Only

- `api` (String) DNS API plugin name.
- `data` (String, Sensitive) DNS plugin data (base64-encoded credentials).
- `digest` (String) Digest of the plugin configuration file.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the plugin config is disabled.
- `nodes` (List of String) Cluster nodes the plugin is limited to; empty means all nodes.
- `type` (String) ACME challenge type of the plugin.
- `validation_delay` (Number) Extra delay in seconds before requesting validation.
